subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
title: Self-awareness
overview: Self-awareness means knowing who you are and why you matter. In this sub-strand you will say your name, notice what makes you different from other people, and learn that God made you. You will read Genesis 1:27 and Psalm 139:13 and thank God for making you His special creation.

lessons.title: My name and what makes me unique
objectives: Say his or her name clearly for identification.
State what is unique about himself or herself.
Explain that being unique means God made each person one of a kind.
lessons.intro: When the teacher calls the register, you answer to your own name. That name tells people who you are. Knowing your name, and knowing what is special about you, is the start of self-awareness.
lessons.notes:
Your name is the first way people identify you. It may be the name your parents gave you at birth, and it may include a family name. When you say it clearly, others know who is speaking. Saying your name is not showing off. It is a simple way of knowing yourself.

### What unique means
Unique means one of a kind. No other learner in the class is exactly like you. You may share a classroom, a language or a favourite game, but God made differences that belong to you.

Things that can be unique about you:

- Your full name
- Your face, height, voice and smile
- What you enjoy and what you can do well
- The way you think, feel and treat other people

Two children can both like singing and still be different people. One may be quiet. Another may speak quickly. Both are valuable.

### Psalm 139:13
Psalm 139:13 says that God formed you inside your mother. He put you together with care before anyone else saw you. Psalm 139:14 says, "I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made." Fearfully, in this verse, means with great care and wonder. Wonderfully means in an amazing way.

You do not need to copy another child's face, voice or marks in order to matter. You already matter because God made you. When you recite Psalm 139:13, pause and thank God for the way He made you.

### Showing respect
Listen when a classmate says his or her name and what is special about them. Do not laugh at a difference. Positive regard for yourself and for others is respect.

keyWords.meaning: one of a kind; not exactly like anyone else

examples.problem: Amina says, "I wish I looked exactly like my friend so that people would like me." What can you tell her from this lesson?
steps: God formed each person with care.
Psalm 139:14 says we are fearfully and wonderfully made.
Amina's own name, face and gifts already make her special.
examples.answer: She does not need to copy her friend. God made her unique, and that is something to thank Him for.

activity.title: Say your name and what is unique about you
steps: Stand in a circle. Each learner says his or her full name clearly.
Each learner states one thing that is unique about himself or herself.
The class listens without laughing and thanks each speaker.
Together, recite Psalm 139:13 and sit quietly for a short time to think about being wonderfully made.
Sing a short song about being special to God.

practice.question: Why do you say your name in class?
practice.answer: So that people can identify who I am.

practice.question: What does unique mean?
practice.answer: One of a kind; not exactly like anyone else.

practice.question: What does Psalm 139:13 teach about you?
practice.answer: God formed me with care inside my mother.

summary: Saying your name helps people identify you.
You are unique because God made you one of a kind.
Psalm 139:13 teaches that God formed you with care.

lessons.title: Created in the image of God
objectives: Read Genesis 1:27 about being created in the image and likeness of God.
Appreciate himself or herself as God's special creation.
lessons.intro: Look at your hands, your eyes and the friends sitting near you. People did not make themselves. The Bible teaches that God is the Creator, and that He made people in His image.
lessons.notes:
### God is the Creator
To acknowledge God as the Creator means to agree that He made the world and He made you. The sun, the plants, the animals and people all come from His work. You are not an accident. You are a creation of God.

### Genesis 1:27
Genesis 1:27 says that God created human beings in His own image and likeness. He created them male and female. Image and likeness do not mean that God has a body like ours. They mean that people can know God, love, choose, speak and care for what He has made.

Because every person is made in God's image:

- You have value that does not depend on marks, clothes or height.
- Other children have the same value. You should not insult them.
- Boys and girls are both God's creation.

### Appreciating God's special creation
To appreciate means to be thankful and to treat something as precious. You appreciate yourself as God's special creation when you:

- Thank God for your life, your name and your body.
- Take care of your body by washing, eating well and resting.
- Use your gifts to help your family and your class.
- Refuse to say, "I am useless," because God does not make useless people.

Singing a song about being God's child is one way to show this thanks. Drawing your face and writing "I am God's special creation" under it is another. When you meditate on Genesis 1:27, you remember that the God who made the world also made you.

keyWords.meaning: the one who makes something; God made the world and people
people are made to reflect God by knowing Him, loving and choosing
to be thankful and to treat something as precious

examples.problem: A boy laughs at a classmate who is shorter than the others. How does Genesis 1:27 correct him?
steps: Genesis 1:27 says God created people in His image.
Height does not decide a person's value.
Both boys are God's special creation and should respect each other.
examples.answer: He should stop laughing. God made both of them in His image, so each one is special.

activity.title: Read Genesis 1:27 and sing
steps: In pairs, say what it means to be created in the image and likeness of God.
Each learner draws his or her face and writes one sentence thanking God the Creator.
Sing a song related to your uniqueness as God's special creation.

practice.question: Who is the Creator of human beings?
What does Genesis 1:27 say about how God created people?
practice.answer: God created them in His own image and likeness, male and female.

practice.question: Give one way you can appreciate yourself as God's special creation.
practice.answer: Any one: thank God for my life; take care of my body; use my gifts to help others; refuse to call myself useless.

summary: God is the Creator of the world and of people.
Genesis 1:27 says people are created in God's image and likeness.
You show appreciation by thanking God and respecting yourself and others.

quiz.question: What does self-awareness mean?
quiz.explanation: Self-awareness is knowing who you are, beginning with your name.

quiz.question: Why do learners say their names?
quiz.explanation: Saying your name helps people identify you.

quiz.question: What does unique mean?
quiz.explanation: A unique person is not exactly like anyone else.

quiz.question: Which verse says that God formed you inside your mother?
quiz.explanation: Psalm 139:13 teaches that God formed each person with care before birth.

quiz.question: "Fearfully and wonderfully made" means that God made you:
options: with great care, in an amazing way
only if you score high marks
quiz.explanation: The words mean God made you carefully and wonderfully.

quiz.question: Who is the Creator?
options: The oldest person in the family
quiz.explanation: Christians acknowledge God as the Creator of the world and of people.

quiz.question: Genesis 1:27 teaches that people are created in the ______ of God.
quiz.explanation: The verse says God created human beings in His image and likeness, male and female.

quiz.question: Why should you not laugh at a classmate who looks different from you?
quiz.answer: Because every person is God's special creation, made in His image.
quiz.explanation: Respect follows from knowing that God made each person unique.

quiz.question: Which action shows that you appreciate yourself as God's creation?
options: Thanking God and taking care of your body
quiz.explanation: Appreciation is shown by thanks and by caring for the life God gave you.

quiz.question: A learner wishes she looked exactly like her friend. What should she remember?
quiz.answer: God made her unique and wonderfully, so she does not need to copy her friend.
quiz.explanation: Psalm 139 and Genesis 1:27 teach that each person is God's special work.
